titleStmt.title: Credit risk prediction for cotton farmers using machine learning

abstract.p: This study compares Random Forest and Logistic Regression for predicting default risk among cotton farmers using a sample of 1200 farmers.

div.head: Methods
div.p: We used a Random Forest classifier and a Logistic Regression baseline, trained on financial and productive variables including income, credit history, and planted area.

div.head: Results
div.p: The Random Forest model achieved an AUC of 0.87 on the test set, using a sample of 1200 farmers from the southern region. The logistic regression baseline achieved an AUC of 0.79.
